description: '''Maidcore''' ({{langx|ru|Мейдкор}}, {{langx|ja|メイドコア}}), also known as '''maid rock''', is an [[underground music|underground]], [[Internet music|Internet-based]] [[fusion genre|fusion]]-[[microgenre]] and [[Music_community#Online_music_communities|online music community]] aesthetically defined by the artists' idiosyncratic [[Persona#In_music|musical persona]]s: [[French maid]]-styled ''[[bishōjo]]'' [[original character]]s, some of them originating from [[Futaba Channel]] in the early 2000s, typically carrying the identifying [[title]] {{gloss|the Maid}}. Popularized on the [[Runet]] website [[VK.com]], the music genre and [[subculture]] are influenced by the [[Otaku#Subculture|''otaku'' subculture]], [[anime and manga fandom]] and [[internet culture]]. Stylistically, maidcore is an eclectic blend of [[post-rock]], [[shoegaze]], [[breakcore]], and [[chiptune]], featuring [[music sampling]].
